title: Can You Have a Wedding or a Vow Renewal on a Boat in Madeira?
description: A vow renewal or symbolic ceremony on a small boat is easy to plan. A legal wedding in Portugal goes through the civil registry: do not count on one at sea.
heroAlt: A small white bouquet and two glasses of wine on a grey boat seat at golden hour
keywords: wedding on a boat in madeira
vow renewal on a boat madeira
getting married in madeira legal requirements
